module(
    name = "classic-diagnostic-adapter",
    version = "0.1.0",
    bazel_compatibility = [">=8.6.0"],
)

bazel_dep(name = "bazel_skylib", version = "1.9.2")
bazel_dep(name = "platforms", version = "1.0.0")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_rust", version = "0.68.1")
single_version_override(
    module_name = "rules_rust",
    version = "0.68.1",
)

bazel_dep(name = "mbedtls-rs", version = "0.1.0")
git_override(
    module_name = "mbedtls-rs",
    commit = "1dac0d8c6a80feb3864e86aac80b35cf34b10f87",
    remote = "https://github.com/eclipse-opensovd/mbedtls-rs.git",
)

rust = use_extension(
    "@rules_rust//rust:extensions.bzl",
    "rust",
    dev_dependency = True,
)
rust.toolchain(
    edition = "2024",
    versions = ["1.88.0"],
)
use_repo(rust, "rust_toolchains")

register_toolchains(
    "@rust_toolchains//:all",
    dev_dependency = True,
)

cda_crate_universe = use_extension(
    "//bazel:cda_crate_extension.bzl",
    "crate",
)
cda_crate_universe.render_config(
    platforms_template = "@classic-diagnostic-adapter//bazel:{triple}",
)
cda_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "libc",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0001-libc-qnx800-target-cfg.patch"],
    version = "=0.2.191",
)
cda_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "memmap2",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0002-memmap2-qnx-posix-advice.patch"],
    version = "=0.9.12",
)
cda_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "linkme-impl",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0003-linkme-impl-qnx-elf.patch"],
    version = "=0.3.38",
)
cda_crate_universe.from_cargo(
    name = "cda_crates",
    cargo_lockfile = "//:Cargo.lock",
    manifests = ["//:Cargo.toml"],
    skip_cargo_lockfile_overwrite = True,
    supported_platform_triples = [
        "aarch64-apple-darwin",
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "aarch64-unknown-nto-qnx710",
        "wasm32-unknown-unknown",
        "wasm32-wasip1",
        "x86_64-pc-nto-qnx710",
        "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "x86_64-unknown-nixos-gnu",
    ],
)
use_repo(
    cda_crate_universe,
    cda_crates = "cda_crates",
    cda_ed25519_dalek = "cda_crates__ed25519-dalek-2.2.0",
)

can_crate_universe = use_extension(
    "//bazel:can_crate_extension.bzl",
    "crate",
)
can_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "libc",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0001-libc-qnx800-target-cfg.patch"],
    version = "=0.2.191",
)
can_crate_universe.spec(
    git = "https://github.com/MarkSchmitt/tokio-socketcan-isotp.git",
    package = "tokio-socketcan-isotp",
    tag = "v0.6.0",
)
can_crate_universe.spec(
    package = "sd-notify",
    version = "=0.5.0",
)
# CAN must share CDA's Tokio crate so sockets can register with its runtime.
can_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "tokio",
    override_target_lib = "@cda_crates//:tokio",
)
can_crate_universe.from_specs(
    name = "can_crates",
)
use_repo(can_crate_universe, "can_crates")
core:
module(
    name = "opensovd_core",
    version = "0.0.0",
    bazel_compatibility = [">=8.6.0"],
)

bazel_dep(name = "rules_rust", version = "0.70.0")
git_override(
    module_name = "rules_rust",
    commit = "00fcbe9395e55b8a15b083f5123806a7fca42f91",
    remote = "https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_rust.git",
)

rust = use_extension(
    "@rules_rust//rust:extensions.bzl",
    "rust",
    dev_dependency = True,
)
rust.toolchain(
    edition = "2024",
    file = "//:rust-toolchain.toml",
)
use_repo(rust, "rust_toolchains")

register_toolchains(
    "@rust_toolchains//:all",
    dev_dependency = True,
)

opensovd_crate_universe = use_extension(
    "@rules_rust//crate_universe:extensions.bzl",
    "crate",
    isolate = True,
)
opensovd_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "aws-lc-sys",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0001-aws-lc-sys-qnx-compiler.patch"],
    version = "=0.47.0",
)
opensovd_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "if-addrs",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0003-if-addrs-qnx-platforms.patch"],
    version = "=0.15.0",
)
opensovd_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "libc",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0002-libc-qnx800-target-cfg.patch"],
    version = "=0.2.191",
)
opensovd_crate_universe.annotation(
    crate = "socket-pktinfo",
    patch_args = ["-p1"],
    patches = ["//:patches/0004-socket-pktinfo-qnx-platforms.patch"],
    version = "=0.4.1",
)
opensovd_crate_universe.from_cargo(
    name = "crate_index",
    cargo_lockfile = "//:Cargo.lock",
    manifests = ["//:Cargo.toml"],
    skip_cargo_lockfile_overwrite = True,
    supported_platform_triples = [
        "aarch64-apple-darwin",
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "aarch64-unknown-nto-qnx710",
        "wasm32-unknown-unknown",
        "wasm32-wasip1",
        "x86_64-pc-nto-qnx710",
        "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu",
        "x86_64-unknown-nixos-gnu",
    ],
)
use_repo(opensovd_crate_universe, "crate_index")
